name: 52653 · Wapello, IA
findings: ZIP 52653 (Wapello) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52653 (Wapello) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 52653 (Wapello) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
